rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); S720: Clovis's 8 records S713 held for Sky, collected with their gaps named where one is honest (no reread)

gaps.lists_not_closed: A choice list prints no unit figure of its own, one that depends on another choice, or also takes courses from another list, so the lists alone cannot add the program's units.
gaps.pair_read_as_alternatives: The catalog prints two courses taken together as one option, and the record reads them as separate alternatives, so its low end falls short of the printed total.
gaps.pool_figure_not_read: The catalog prints one figure over several lists or nested options together, and the record adds the parts instead, so its units cannot be checked against that figure.

held.why: held: two 'Select a minimum' lists add to 11 against 18, and its notes name no line for the other 7; a reread
held: #3683 pins it to pp.106-107 (through); it waits on that pinned reread
held: coverage fails (ANTHRO 13, ECON C2001 not placed); the census counts a gap only where coverage passes
held: its note only suspects MATH C2210 and the statistics course are alternatives (42 against 39-42); a reread
held: the record holds only the elective list (1-4 against 18-21) and carries no note; the core is unread

records.words: Catalog states 'Select additional units from the above areas to total at least 18 units.' The core (4) plus minimums (8 + 3) total 15, so 3 more units must come from the listed areas; these are not open electives and are not recorded in open_elective_units.

program.section_heading: PHYSICAL EDUCATION (MAJOR #C.4200.AA) ASSOCIATE IN ARTS DEGREE
outcomes: Plan, implement, practice, and measure appropriate fitness activities which promote improved levels of muscular strength and endurance, cardio-respiratory endurance, flexibility, and body composition.
Acquire skills and/or knowledge of skill sets, demonstrate basic knowledge of rules and/or terminology, and identify necessary equipment for specific physical activities.
Recognize the relationship between physical activity and physical wellness.
Recognize the impact of physical activity has on cognitive functioning and/or emotional wellness.
Recognize the social and financial implications of inadequate physical activity.

blocks.name: Complete a minimum of eight units from the following
Select three units from the following

records.words: List C also allows 'Any course from List A or List B not already used' (3 units); not recorded as separate codes.

program.section_heading: Associate in Arts in Art History for Transfer Degree

records.words: List A prints paired selections: 'CHEM 1A AND CHEM 1B' and 'CHEM 28A AND CHEM 29A' each appear to count as one selection; the schema cannot express AND pairs, so the courses are listed individually in List A. Maximum of two selections ('one to two courses') is not captured by the schema.

program.section_heading: NUTRITION AND DIETETICS ASSOCIATE IN SCIENCE IN NUTRITION AND DIETETICS FOR TRANSFER DEGREE (Major #C.5683.AS-T)
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge of the relationship of nutrients and lifestyle factors and the associated risk of chronic disease.
Demonstrate knowledge of physiological processes such as digestion, absorption, transport and metabolism of nutrients.
Identify essential nutrients and describe their chemical structures and food sources.
Recognize and separate scientifically supported information from misinformation
Identify ways in which social factors influence food related choices, practices and beliefs.

blocks.name: List A: Select one to two courses

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score; checks.arithmetic, coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found. The capture keeps no page text, so a note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.

select json_build_object(
  'listed', (select count(*) from v),
  'on_run', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run),
  'record_is_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.record = v.before_record),
  'checks_is_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.checks = v.before_checks),
  'both_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.record = v.before_record and r.checks = v.before_checks),
  'already_after', count(*) filter (where r.checks = v.after_checks),
  'checked_now', count(*) filter (where r.checked),
  'confirm_matches', count(*) filter (where lv.verdict = 'confirm'

  left join lateral (select pv.verdict, pv.requirements_fp from public.program_record_verdicts pv
                      where pv.college = v.college and pv.control_number = v.control_number
                      order by pv.id desc limit 1) lv on true;
